text:
zoe-partners: Quick sync 1: partner (LumenGate) wants to list their gateway. Marketplace asks for signed firmware, SBOM, SOC2 pointer, redacted pen-test, and chain-of-custody. Can we agree minimal bundle + upload flow?

trent-security: Minimal bundle = SOC2 summary URL, redacted pentest PDF (no customer PII), CycloneDX SBOM, detached firmware signatures plus an RFC3161 timestamp token, signer cert chain (PEM), and a signed chain-of-custody PDF. Include KMS/HSM identifier or timestamping receipt.

maya-eng: Packaging: one attest tar.gz per release at lumen/<version>/attest.tar.gz containing files + manifest.json at root with sha256 map. README.md with redaction notes and contact.

paul-hw: LumenGate here 1: we produce detached .sig files and can get RFC3161 timestamps from TimeStampPro. HSM attestation logs are large; can we reference them instead of embedding?

trent-security: Reference ok if it's a signed retrieval URL + hash. For audit we prefer full logs but short references accepted if they include proof-of-hash.

hiro-ps: Upload flow: partner requests presigned multipart upload to s3://redwood-partner-ingest/lumen/<version>/attest.tar.gz. Default presign TTL = 86400s (24h). For >24h or >10GB we need ops approval. After upload partner posts manifest hash + ETag. Security will then perform redaction verification. Target turnaround: 7 business days.

ops-bot: policy: partner-ingest bucket presign max TTL=86400s. Multipart presign supported. Tag requests "presign-extend" for >86400s or >10GB; ops approval required. Audit logs enabled.

paul-hw: 24h works. Can you share manifest template and an example presign command?

maya-eng: Example presign (single PUT):
```
aws s3 presign put-object --bucket redwood-partner-ingest --key lumen/v1.0.0/attest.tar.gz --expires-in 86400
```
For multipart we generate per-part presigns after create-multipart-upload.

hiro-ps: Manifest template uploaded: https://drive.redwood/lumen-manifest-template.json (fields: vendor, version, release_timestamp, files -> sha256, signer_cert_chain_pem, signature_files, sbom_filename, soc2_summary_url, pentest_redacted_filename, chain_of_custody_filename, hsm_attestation_ref, contact_email, redaction_approver).

trent-security: Redaction checklist: redact customer names, internal IPs/hostnames, PII. Keep CVE IDs, CVSS, and remediation status. Redaction approver must sign the manifest field `redaction_approved_by` before ingest.

zoe-partners: Action items captured: - Paul/LumenGate: assemble attest.tar.gz + manifest (owner: paul-hw) - Maya: confirm presign/multipart doc (owner: maya-eng) - Trent: redaction checklist + reserve review slot (owner: trent-security) - Hiro: publish manifest template + S3 prefix (owner: hiro-ps)

paul-hw: Starting today. ETA upload request by 1736012000. Will request presigns when ready.

ops-bot: ingest prefix: s3://redwood-partner-ingest/lumen/  presign-policy: max 86400s  audit: enabled.

trent-security: I'll schedule a 30m redaction review after upload. Tag me.

zoe-partners: Thanks all. I'll coordinate marketplace listing owner after artifacts signoff. :thumbsup:
